title: Choose one cinematic proof before expanding the film
promptExcerpt: Refine the Manhattan 2150 scene into a strong portfolio image and six-shot sequence.
decision: Prioritize one polished skyline keyframe, then use the storyboard to show the broader direction.
result: The case study has a focused hero asset and a production-ready narrative outline without overstating completion.
learning: A single art-directed proof can communicate more craft than a large set of uneven generated frames.
